name: Blackberry Jelly
subtitle: Clear fruit jelly with apple and lemon
description: A small-batch blackberry jelly made by cooking fruit, straining it through muslin, and finishing the juice with preserving sugar.

ingredients.item: cooking apple (1 medium sized cooking apple)

instructions.text: Prepare two clean 300 ml jars. Cut the cooking apple into small pieces and juice the lemon.
Preheat the cooking vessel for 15 minutes, then add the blackberries, apple, and lemon juice. Stir and cook until the fruit softens.
Line a strainer with the muslin cloth and transfer the cooked fruit into it. Leave the juice to drain through without pressing the pulp.
Measure the strained juice and add the preserving sugar. Heat, stirring, until the sugar dissolves, then simmer until the jelly reaches a setting consistency.
Transfer the hot jelly to the prepared jars, allow it to cool, and serve or store as appropriate.
